notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Saproling.
description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Priest of Urabrask and Slimefoot and Squee, adding two mana in any combination of {B}, {R} or {G}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Priest of Urabrask from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Urabrask and Slimefoot and Squee enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Priest of Urabrask trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Slimefoot and Squee trigger, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.
